en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard depicting a large, ornate Gothic-style building with a tall central tower. The building appears to be made of stone and features steep gables, pointed arches, and numerous windows. The setting is an open square with a few people walking and surrounding historic buildings. The text identifies the scene as 'Poorterslogie' in Bruges, a historic city in Belgium, and references the 14th century (XIVe Siècle).
